# STEP · IIT Kharagpur

> Science & Technology Entrepreneurs' Park (STEP) at IIT Kharagpur is a pioneer technology incubator fostering deep-tech innovation and venture creation since 1986.

## Overview
STEP IIT Kharagpur provides incubation support, seed capital, laboratory access, domain mentoring, and ecosystem networking to technology startups and innovators.

## Key Sections
- Home: Incubation management platform, updates, and highlights.
- Incubation Application: Process and portal for startups seeking incubation or funding support.
- Portfolio Startups: Catalog of incubated startups, alumni companies, and deep-tech innovations.

## Target Audience
- Founders & Innovators seeking seed funding and physical/virtual incubation.
- Industry Partners, Mentors, and Investors looking to engage with IIT Kharagpur startups.
